ruling.recommended_action: Refer to Trust & Safety for human review of the driver's threatening chat message; preserve chat/call records and trip telemetry; consider interim suspension of the driver pending review; hold the $5.00 no-show fee pending outcome.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen (SAFE-1): the driver's chat message at 17:15:10 — "Hurry up or I will find you and you will regret it." — is a threat directed at the rider, sent just before he cancelled. This is a safety indicator, and the rider's complaint ("the driver threatened me in the chat") confirms the rider's own perception. Under SAFE-1 the case must be escalated for human review regardless of the filed dispute type (no_show_charge), and under SAFE-3 the AI may not rule on the merits or recommend an outcome for the safety element.

Factual summary for the reviewer (no fault finding): trip T-2044, Bugis Junction → Jurong East MRT, driver assigned 17:08:00, driver_arrived event 17:10:00 and GPS shows the vehicle stationary at the pickup point (≈1.29927, 103.85585 vs pickup 1.2994, 103.8555 — within ~30 m) from 17:10 to 17:15:30. Rider messaged "2 min, coming" at 17:12:00. The driver's only call attempt at 17:11:30 was unanswered (0 s), and he sent one in-app message (17:10:30). Driver cancelled at 17:15:30 for rider_no_show; a $5.00 cancellation fee was recorded. Note the timings (whether the free-wait/no-show threshold was actually met, in light of the unanswered call and the 17:12 "2 min" message) should be assessed by the human reviewer alongside the safety question; this ruling assigns no fault.

Evidence status: sufficient for the safety escalation (the threat is recorded in the system chat log with a timestamp), so no outcome-relevant record is missing for the escalation decision itself.
ruling.escalation_reason: Threatening message from driver to rider in in-app chat immediately before cancellation — mandatory SAFE-1 human escalation regardless of dispute type; AI is barred from ruling on the merits (SAFE-3).

element_findings.reason: Driver's chat message of 17:15:10 — "Hurry up or I will find you and you will regret it." — is a threat of harm directed at the rider, read in context, and is not a pickup arrangement or harmless wording.

rejected_claims.reason: Not adjudicated: escalation under SAFE-1/SAFE-3 bars the AI from ruling on the merits; fee held pending human review. Timings noted for reviewer (call at 17:11:30 unanswered, rider '2 min' at 17:12:00, cancel 17:15:30).
